_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); athletic footwear and apparel signals

pit_profile.why: NIKE: 'NIKE is the largest seller of athletic footwear and athletic apparel in the world', and 'Virtually all of our products are manufactured by independent contractors' (its own FY2007 10-K); the industry 'is keenly competitive in the United States and on a worldwide basis', 'including Adidas, Puma, and others', and 'the relative popularity of various sports and fitness activities and changing design trends affect the demand for our products': a demand and fashion risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: NIKE: 'NIKE is the largest seller of athletic footwear and athletic apparel in the world', and 'Virtually all of our products are manufactured by independent contractors' (its own FY2007 10-K); the industry 'is keenly competitive in the United States and on a worldwide basis', 'including Adidas, Puma, and others', and 'the relative popularity of various sports and fitness activities and changing design trends affect the demand for our products': a demand and fashion risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.79x; +48% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.32; conservative 2yr +6%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY98-FY07, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +11.6%/yr (Q3 rev ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +17.7%/yr (FY98-FY07 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +27.4%/yr (best 2-yr run FY98-FY07); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: NKE (retrospective, 2008-05-09) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.79x (30.6% downside to Bear $45 / +38.7% upside to Bull $90) | Adj composite 2.96 vs market 2.64: gap +0.32 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +48% above the EPP floor $44 (15x FY08E $2.93) | Conservative 2-yr case: +6.1% total (+3.0%/yr) | At 22.1x FY08E the 15% hurdle price $86 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; futures orders +11.0% in Q3 FY08, forward revenues +10% (Q3 FY08 revenue ex-currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
